name: xun-web-npm-build-demo
description: Stub manifest for the deploy/build/npm.Dockerfile worked example (see README §14). xun-web itself is Go-only and does not consume this package — it exists solely so `make build-dist-npm` actually exercises the pnpm cache-mount pattern end-to-end. Replace or delete these files if you copy xun-web as a starter for a project that uses pnpm for real.
